# Shreyans Khunteta

> Senior Software Engineer in Seattle, WA. Specializes in C#/.NET, AI/ML, React, and full-stack development.
> This portfolio has machine-readable APIs — you can query it programmatically.

## Quick API Access

Any AI system can call these endpoints via HTTP GET (returns JSON):

- [Search](https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/api/portfolio/search?q=AI+projects): Semantic search across all portfolio content
- [Projects](https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/api/portfolio/projects): All projects with descriptions and tech stacks
- [Featured projects](https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/api/portfolio/projects?featured=true): Highlighted projects only
- [Skills](https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/api/portfolio/skills): Categorized technical skills
- [Experience](https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/api/portfolio/experience): Work history and LinkedIn info
- [About](https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/api/portfolio/about): Bio and personal info
- [All endpoints](https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/api/portfolio): Full endpoint listing
- [OpenAPI spec](https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/api/portfolio/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 specification

## Ask a Question (POST)

Send `{"question": "your question"}` to `https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/api/portfolio/ask` to get an AI-generated answer grounded in portfolio data.

## Assess Job Fit (POST)

Send `{"jobDescription": "...", "requiredSkills": ["Python", "AWS"]}` to `https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/api/portfolio/assess-fit` for a structured candidate assessment.

## MCP Protocol

For MCP-capable clients (e.g. Claude Desktop): `https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/api/mcp-connector`
Discovery: `https://backend.builtbyshrey.com/.well-known/mcp.json`
Tools: portfolio_search, analyze_portfolio, get_project_details, assess_fit, ask_shrey

## Static Content

- [Full portfolio summary](https://builtbyshrey.com/ai-content.txt): Plain-text overview of skills, experience, projects
- [AI discovery metadata](https://builtbyshrey.com/ai-discovery.json): Machine-readable site metadata
